description:
COADM01C performs no dataset access whatsoever. It declares no SELECT and no FD, and its five EXEC CICS statements are one RETURN at 107-110, two XCTLs at 142-145 and 165-167, one SEND MAP at 179-184 and one RECEIVE MAP at 191-197 - not one of them a file command. That absence is behaviour, and this case asserts it positively rather than by omission: the security file IS seeded, at the eighty bytes app/cpy/CSUSR01Y.cpy declares, so it is present and readable for the whole run - and both record channels of the fingerprint must still come back completely empty, with no dataset named on either. Seeding without expecting is the whole point; a case that simply omitted the dataset could not tell 'the unit read nothing' from 'nobody looked'. The emptiness is stated as an empty expectedWrites and an empty expectedFinalState and NOT as a dataset-level expectation, because a dataset-level expectation asserts that the dataset was opened or created, which is the opposite of what this program does.

The ten seed rows are the in-stream data of app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl, 57 characters as that JCL carries them, widened to the declared 80 by the one recorded deviation for this dataset - USRSEC_FILLER_PAD_57_TO_80, which restores SEC-USR-FILLER PIC X(23) and takes 8+20+20+8+1+23 back to the copybook's 80. The same JCL's own DCB says LRECL=80, so the pad restores a declared width rather than inventing one. The literal SEC-USR-PWD span in those rows is the legacy design's placeholder value and not a credential; it stays in plaintext because a plaintext comparison is what COSGN00C performs and hashing it would be a behaviour change, and COADM01C never reads the field at all.

The path is MAIN-PARA's first-entry arm. EIBCALEN is 160, the length of CARDDEMO-COMMAREA, so the guard at line 82 falls through to line 86; CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT arrives 0, so IF NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER at line 87 is true. Line 88 sets the flag, which is why the response carries context 1 where the request carried 0 - the single communication-area field this path mutates, and the reason the conversation is resumable without any server-side session. Line 89 moves LOW-VALUES over the whole of COADM1AO and line 90 sends. No option is read and no validation runs on this arm, so PROCESS-ENTER-KEY is never entered: OPTIONO stays at the X'00' line 89 left it, because the only statement that writes it is line 125 inside that paragraph, and mapFields is empty because nothing is received. OPTN001O through OPTN004O are the four lines BUILD-MENU-OPTIONS composes at 226-263 - CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-NUM PIC 9(02), the literal '. ', then CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-NAME PIC X(35), all three DELIMITED BY SIZE into a PIC X(40), which is 39 composed bytes into a forty-byte field that line 231 had just moved SPACES over, so byte 40 of each line is that space and not a pad this fixture invented - and OPTN005O through OPTN012O stay X'00' because CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-COUNT is 4 and the PERFORM VARYING at 228-229 stops there. WS-MESSAGE is the eighty spaces line 79 moved into it: this arm composes no message, which is a different fact from a blank message being sent after an error and is why the eighty-byte image is asserted rather than assumed. ERRMSGC is DFHRED, the COLOR=RED that app/bms/COADM01.bms:154-157 declares for ERRMSG, because the program contains exactly one attribute-byte write - MOVE DFHGREEN TO ERRMSGC at line 148 - and it is not on this path. The response names COADM01 and COADM1A and names no successor at all, because no XCTL runs here, so the termination is the EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID(WS-TRANID) COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) at 107-110. The return code is 0: COADM01C is reached by CICS transaction CA00 rather than by EXEC PGM=, contains no CALL 'CEE3ABD' and sets no RETURN-CODE of its own.

Where the 'DUMMY' five-byte-prefix arm is driven, stated here so that a reader looking for it in this case is not misled: it is case08 of this same directory. Line 138's IF CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-PGMNAME(WS-OPTION)(1:5) NOT = 'DUMMY' cannot be taken false from the shipped table at all - app/cpy/COADM02Y.cpy's four active entries name COUSR00C, COUSR01C, COUSR02C and COUSR03C, not one of which begins DUMMY, and the guard at 127-129 rejects every subscript above CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-COUNT, so slots 5 to 9 of the OCCURS 9 table are unreachable too. The arm, the coming-soon STRING at 149-153 whose CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-NAME operand at 150-151 is commented out, and the DFHGREEN override at 148 are therefore dead-but-present code; they are preserved verbatim and exercised rather than tidied away. They are reached by substituting the option table, and that substitution is a Java-side seam - AdminMenuService.handle(input, optionTable) against a single entry differing from the copybook's first in nothing but its program name, so the program name is the only variable under test - because ParityCase publishes no option-table member and refuses jobParameters for any unit kind other than BATCH_JOB, a job parameter being a JCL PARM. app/cpy/COADM02Y.cpy is never edited to reach it and the shipped default is never altered. This is recorded here rather than resolved silently.

One reading of the source that governs that arm and is easy to get backwards, stated because it was verified against the listing rather than assumed: line 138's IF closes at line 146 and encloses lines 139 to 145 - the three moves to CDEMO-FROM-TRANID, CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM and CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT and the XCTL itself. Lines 147 to 154 sit outside that IF but inside the IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON of line 137, which closes at 155. So when the prefix IS 'DUMMY' the transfer is skipped and those three communication-area moves are skipped with it, and the coming-soon paint runs on the communication area exactly as it arrived; WS-ERR-FLG stays 'N', because a suppressed transfer is a successful outcome rather than a rejection. None of lines 137 to 155 is reached on this case's path.

The clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:12:32, the timestamp COADM01C's own version footer at line 267 carries, so the instant is anchored in the source rather than chosen, and US-ASCII is named explicitly rather than left to a platform default. All twenty cases in this directory pin that same instant, so no two of them can differ by their clock. A service run asserts no header: POPULATE-HEADER-INFO's six fields at 202-221 are projected by the controller, and only the four controller cases carry them, so the pinned instant changes nothing this case asserts and is declared all the same.

Every expected value above is statically derived - read out of the COBOL paragraph that produces it and cross-checked against the 80-byte layout of app/cpy/CSUSR01Y.cpy, the 405-byte option table of app/cpy/COADM02Y.cpy, the 160-byte layout of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, whose sixteen fields give the response's sixteen navigation widths (4, 8, 4, 8, 8, 1, 1, 9, 25, 25, 25, 11, 1, 16, 7 and 7, summing to 160), the xxxI PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COADM01.CPY and the DFHMDF definitions of app/bms/COADM01.bms - and none of it was captured from an execution of the legacy program, which is empirically impossible here: no z/OS or CICS runtime, an indexed file handler the available compiler reports as disabled, no Language Environment CEE services, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR absent from the repository. ParityHarness's class documentation is the authoritative statement of that provenance, and the substitution is escalated rather than absorbed (risk R-A).
